clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Jergosh the Invoker plots against the Horde. He leads Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm and practices demonic arts while Thrall guides the orcs toward honor and shamanism.

Jergosh gathers the Searing Blade beneath Orgrimmar. While Thrall leads the orcs toward honor and shamanism, Jergosh turns to demonic power. He hides in Ragefire Chasm, where he draws followers into a sect aligned with the remnants of the Shadow Council. From below the Horde capital, the cult works against the path the new Horde has chosen.
